about: table_climb in the WM 2000 arena: every 10 s THE ROCK (the CPU) is put beside the announce table, at the announcers' depth or its front, from the right or the left, and runs at it (qa_table). The table's walls (announce.c: its front at -455, back on the barricade's -690 line) and the game's -z barricade walls stand (arena_ring.c leaves them alone for this arena): never up at the table's height away from the ring and the table's top, never past the barricade

expect.name: never up at the table's height off the table and away from the ring
expect.check: not (s0_y > 45 and not (abs(s0_x) < 280 and abs(s0_z) < 280) and not (abs(s0_x) < 120 and s0_z > -620 and s0_z < -440) and s0_z < 500)

expect.name: nobody's position went bad
expect.check: finite(s0_x, s0_y, s0_z, s1_x, s1_y, s1_z)
